title: Wire formats are permanent; never rename product tokens
context: Early decisions about identifiers and namespaces propagate to every tool repository ever written.
decision: .kaava extension, kaava/* RPC namespace, kaava-tool:// scheme, @openkaava/* scope, crate names, and bundle identifier must never be renamed. Managed via branding.toml; product marketing name changes but wire formats do not.
consequences: Backward compatibility is mandatory for wire formats. Renaming any of these breaks every tool repository written against this shell. These are not branding—they are protocol.
